**Install:** download `squish-*.apk` below on your Android phone and open it. Android asks once to allow installs from your browser or file manager. Each release is signed with the same key, so it installs over the previous one.

**Use:** in Discord, tap **+** → **Files** → ☰ → **Squish**, or share photos and videos to **Squish for Discord**. Set your upload limit in the Squish app (Free 20 MB by default).
